payload.title: gateway-api composes its supergraph on the main thread at boot and the event loop stalls for about 16 s: NATS connections and TLS handshakes started in that window wait or time out, and the HTTP server cannot answer meanwhile
evidence: apps/gateway-api/src/app.module.ts:285 (RetryableIntrospectAndCompose composes the supergraph in-process, on the main thread)
payload.rule_violated: A CPU-bound step at boot does not hold the event loop long enough to break network handshakes or health checks
payload.notes: Production gateway boots on 2026-11-01 at 19:01 and 19:55: composition started at :04.2 and :45.4 and succeeded at :20.4 and 01.1; the three bridges that had begun connecting all connected within 0.11 s after composition ended, and the broker logged a TLS handshake i/o timeout for the fourth while composition ran. In the 19:00 boot the bridges connected in 0.7 s, before composition did its work. Not proven with an event-loop lag measurement yet; that measurement is the first step of the fix.
